$comment: SKILL LAW — the one registry that decides which skill must be used when. Read by .claude/hooks/skill_law.py (UserPromptSubmit routes, PreToolUse gates, PostToolUse ledger, SessionStart cheat sheet). Edit THIS file to change the law; the hook has no hardcoded routes. law: 'gate' = edits are DENIED until one listed skill ran after the prompt; 'advise' = injected as a forced decision, never blocks. Owner waiver: put the skip word in the prompt.

intents.label: BUG
intents.why: find the root cause before changing code

intents.label: PRODUCT QUALITY
intents.why: think first with parallel lenses before fixing

intents.label: SECURITY
intents.why: load the invariants; review the diff for vulnerabilities

intents.label: DESIGN / UI
intents.why: critique against usability, hierarchy and accessibility before restyling

intents.label: NEW FEATURE
intents.why: explore intent and write the plan before code; split work by model

intents.label: PLAN / ARCHITECTURE
intents.why: decide the design and its trade-offs before touching files

intents.label: TESTS
intents.why: write the failing test first; pick the right test level

intents.label: REVIEW
intents.why: review the diff with a dedicated reviewer, not by eye

intents.label: LIVE PRODUCTION
intents.why: diagnose against prod first (Sentry, Railway logs, DB), then verify like a user

intents.label: SHIP / MERGE
intents.why: finish the branch the safe way; check the deploy after merge

intents.label: UNDERSTAND
intents.why: answer from instruments (file:line, live query), never from memory
intents.pattern: \b(how does|how do(es)? (it|this)|explain|walk me through|what is|why (does|is|did)|where is|understand)\b

intents.label: DOCS
intents.why: keep docs and code in sync with the doc tooling

intents.label: RESEARCH
intents.why: multi-source research with citations, not memory

intents.label: CLAUDE API
intents.why: model ids, pricing and SDK change — read the reference first

intents.label: AGENTS / DELEGATION
intents.why: pick the model per sub-task; fan out independent work

intents.label: HARNESS / CONFIG
intents.why: hooks and settings have exact contracts — use the config skills

intents.label: DATA / SQL
intents.why: write correct, efficient SQL against the real schema

paths.label: HARD-RULES ZONE
paths.why: schema, spine, MCP, DB door, auth and profile extraction carry invariants that break prod (CLAUDE.md: read them before editing)

paths.label: FRONTEND UI
paths.why: UI changes are judged by users — critique and check accessibility
